carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal feature is present on the upper flank, defined by a distinct luminance gradient with a light-reflective upper boundary and a shadow-casting lower boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint, irregular white linear mark is visible on the lower flank just above the pectoral fin, consistent with a superficial healed scar.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more irregularly shaped high-intensity pixel clusters compared to the larger, more uniform blobs on the posterior flank.
